thread:
Priya T.: quick sync: brought up lynx-11b v2 (baseline fp16) and ran int6 quant on our `longform-assist` slice. numbers below.
Luca M.: nice, which dataset/slice?
Priya T.: longform-assist-500 (avg 980 tokens). metrics: fp16 Rouge-L 41.2 / BERTScore 0.885. int8 Rouge-L 39.9 / BERTScore 0.879. int6 Rouge-L 38.7 / BERTScore 0.872. p95 latency fp16=720ms int8=520ms int6=410ms. throughput (tokens/sec) +1.6x int8, +2.1x int6.
Anya S.: cost numbers? rough unit econ?
Priya T.: cost/1k tokens: fp16=$0.062, int8=$0.041, int6=$0.030. Baseline site tokens/month ~150M. If we route 30% to int6, raw infra savings ~= $7.02k/mo.
Samir B.: what's the quality hit at 30%? do we see user-visible regressions or only marginal?
Priya T.: Auto-eval (n=1000 samples): int6 mean Rouge-L drop = 2.5 pts vs fp16 (sd 1.2). BERTScore drop ~0.013. Hallucinations flagged 9/1000 (0.9%) vs fp16 0.3%. Most failures are omitted reasoning chains on >1200-token context.
Luca M.: 0.9% hallucination is borderline for compliance/legal. Which intents are affected?
Priya T.: Concentrated in "policy-explain" and "billing-dispute" intents. For casual summarization and brainstorming it's fine.
Anya S.: Product: we can accept small fidelity losses for discovery/assist but not for policy/billing. Suggest routing by intent + confidence signal.
Priya T.: Agreed. Proposed routing proto:
```yaml
route: longform-assist
rules:
  - if intent in [policy-explain, billing-dispute, legal_doc] then model: lynx-11b-fp16
  - elif model_confidence < 0.65 then model: lynx-11b-fp16
  - else model: lynx-11b-int6
fallback: lynx-11b-fp16
metrics: rouge_l, bertscore, hallucination_rate, cost_delta
```
Samir B.: Add a tiny discriminator classifier for "requires-precise-reasoning" at the edge (cheap logits-based) to reduce false negatives.
Luca M.: Also propose a 2% fp16 holdback for drift detection + weekly sampling to the QA team.
Priya T.: My econ back-of-envelope: routing 30% -> int6 saves $7k/mo. Estimated escalation + QA overhead for those mispredicted flows ~$2.8k/mo -> net ~$4.2k/mo. If discriminator reduces bad routing by 50% net becomes ~$5.6k/mo.
Anya S.: Product asks for guardrails: (1) 24h dashboard showing rouge_l delta, hallucination counts by intent, cost delta; (2) rollback if hallucination_rate > 1% over 6h for policy/billing or rouge_l drop > 2.0 for 12h.
eval-bot: Auto-eval: sampled 200 recent live queries -> int6 rouge_l drop mean=2.3 (sd 1.0). Hallucination flagged in 3/200 (1.5%) but manual review reduced to 2/200 (1.0%). Confidence classifier would have caught 1 of 2.
Priya T.: Canary plan: 72h small canary (5% non-sensitive), then 7 day ramp to 30% with 2% fp16 holdback and daily auto-eval. Rollback triggers per Anya's thresholds.
Samir B.: I'll prototype the edge discriminator and add a metric hook for "classifier_false_neg" to dashboard. ETA 3 days.
Luca M.: Also add per-intent cost tracking so finance can see real $ by intent.
Anya S.: Please include explicit compliance signoff before enabling for policy-explain/billing-dispute.
Priya T.: Will create GTN README + reproducible eval notebooks + cost sheet. Draft link: https://go/redwood/lynx11b-int6-checkin (internal).
Luca M.: thanks — if the discriminator shows >80% precision on catching risky queries, we can consider 40% long-term.
Priya T.: noted. launching canary now. will post updates to this thread. :rocket:
